description: This Geoscience Australia dataset is the table behind the Australian Operating Mines Map 2021, the twenty-second edition published in March 2022. The data.gov.au entries say the map shows the location and status at 31 December 2021 of Australian operating mines, mines under development (with a positive feasibility study, started development or all approvals) and mines under care and maintenance with known resource estimates. The data were created on 8 July 2022 by A. Hughes of Geoscience Australia as one downloadable Excel workbook of about 86 KB, with the map itself as a 17.7 MB PDF; the DataCite record gives a CC BY 4.0 licence, so it is free to reuse, while data.gov.au lists the licence as not specified. Coverage is national for Australia. Caveats: it is a snapshot at the end of 2021, and the columns (such as commodity and operator) are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives located operating and developing mines for hazard exposure of Australian mining regions to cyclones, floods and bushfires, and for rail, port and power demand models of mining supply chains. Related catalogue records include the Australian Mine Waste Database, the Australian mine production dataset 1799 to 2021 and the Geoscience Australia OZMIN mineral deposits database.
